summary: Layout (Digital): the committed routed GDS of the LibreLane flow (gds workflow run 38071502150 at f8428aa: TinyTapeout/tt-gds-action@ihp-cmos5l, LibreLane 3.1.0.dev3, IHP-Open-PDK 2bbec755), placed and routed from the LibreLane gate-level netlist reference-asrouted.v by the committed flow (.github/workflows/gds.yaml, src/config.json, src/pdn_cfg.tcl, info.yaml). The design is the merge of issue #208 (DR 0015's P1 and P2, the LibreLane-only drive buffers on every SRAM macro input) with main's issue #139 (the 223-word UART-load boot ROM); src/ and rtl/ at the branch head are byte-identical to f8428aa's. DRC/LVS of these bytes: librelane-gds-signoff-check 20261010-175000-f8428aa. PR #212.
